rules.title: Security Deposit Maximum Amount
rules.requirement: A landlord may request a security deposit, but it cannot exceed the amount of one month's rent.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies where a security deposit is requested.

rules.quoted_span: A security deposit cannot be more than the amount of 1 month’s rent.

rules.title: Security Deposit Return Deadline
rules.requirement: Within 30 days of the end of the lease or tenancy, the landlord must return the security deposit with accrued interest or provide an itemized list of damages and repair costs for any portion being withheld.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential tenancies with security deposits.

rules.quoted_span: Within 30 days of the end of the lease or tenancy, your landlord must return the deposit with any interest that has accrued or give an itemized list of the damages and cost to fix them for whatever portion that is being kept.
